title: Move-up buyer won't proceed without wife
scenario: Father of three wants a bigger house but repeatedly defers to his wife, who handles the family finances. The rep schedules a joint call.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hey, is this Graham? This is Leon calling from Copperleaf Home Loans.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yep, that's me. Hey Leon.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Thanks for picking up. I saw you were asking about a purchase loan for a bigger place?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, we've got three kids in a three-bedroom ranch. It's, uh, getting tight. Real tight.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: I bet. Are you planning to sell the current home first, or buy before you sell?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: That's the million-dollar question. Probably sell first? I don't know.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Okay. Do you know roughly what you owe on the current place?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Maybe one-sixty. We've been there nine years.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: So likely some good equity there. What price range are you looking at for the next house?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Honestly, my wife Renata handles all the money stuff. I really can't go further without her on the call.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That makes total sense, it's a big family decision. Would it work to set up a time when you're both available?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, I think so. She'd kill me if I did this without her, ha.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Ha, we definitely don't want that. Are evenings better for you two?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, after the kids are down. Like eight-thirty?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: I can do eight-thirty. How about Tuesday?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Tuesday at eight-thirty works.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Great. In the meantime, is there anything you're curious about that I can help with now?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Not really, I'd rather wait till Renata's on. She's going to have all the questions anyway.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Fair enough. I'll send a calendar invite to the email on the form. Does that go to you or both of you?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Just me, but I'll forward it.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Perfect. Talk to you both Tuesday, Graham.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Sounds good. Thanks, Leon.
